## Compliance Checklist

- [ ] No diagnosis, treatment, cure, disease prevention, disease reversal, liver repair, insomnia treatment, depression improvement, blood pressure reduction, blood sugar reduction, anti-cancer, or equivalent claims were added.
- [ ] Public copy stays educational, cautious, and non-diagnostic.
- [ ] HIGH and urgent assessment paths do not show product purchase CTAs.
- [ ] Doctor/pharmacist consultation guidance appears for elevated-risk paths.
- [ ] Required consent and optional marketing consent are separate.
- [ ] Optional marketing consent is not pre-checked.
- [ ] Analytics payloads exclude PII and raw health answers.
- [ ] Personal health result pages are noindex when touched.
- [ ] Product Passport cautions appear before commerce actions when product surfaces changed.
